added: Release of LucidPad.
Support for multiple tabs to handle notes and documents.
Added a floating toolbar for quick access to essential formatting tools.
Connected and activated the menu bar across the app.
improved: Refined tab visuals for a cleaner and more readable layout.

added: Introduced a find bar to quickly locate text within documents.
Implemented custom caret rendering for better visual clarity.
improved: Improved focus handling to make editor interactions more reliable.

added: Added a side panel with Outline, Backlinks, and Tags support.
Panels are now resizable and animated for smoother interaction.
improved: Outline tracking is now more accurate and responsive.

added: Introduced the Activity Center for centralized notifications.
Added toast notifications with an undo option for quick recovery.
improved: Footer status indicators are now clearer and easier to interact with.

added: Added a download overlay showing progress, speed, and ETA.
Downloads can now be paused, resumed, or cancelled.
improved: Improved internal telemetry and logging for better diagnostics.
fixed: Resolved edge cases that caused downloads to stall indefinitely.

added: Introduced a streamlined update flow.
Added interactive progress indicators during updates.
improved: Activity Center now provides clearer update-related information.
fixed: Fixed several update-related errors that lacked proper feedback.

added: Added an About dialog with project and author information.
Introduced a built-in changelog viewer with search and copy support.
improved: Modal animations have been refined for smoother transitions.

added: Added a dedicated “What’s New” tab for recent changes.
Introduced a welcome tips modal for first-time users.
improved: Improved the layout and readability of the changelog.

added: Introduced a settings page with configurable options.
Added preset accent colors for quick personalization.
improved: Settings animations are now smoother and more consistent.

added: Implemented auto-save to prevent accidental data loss.
Added toggles for word wrap and spellcheck.
improved: User preferences now persist reliably between sessions.

added: Added active line highlighting for better readability.
Introduced an optional blur/glass UI effect.
improved: Scrolling and editor calculations have been significantly stabilized.

added: Added startup behavior toggles.
Introduced options to disable update and error notifications.
improved: Error messages now provide clearer and more actionable feedback.

added: Added overwrite protection to prevent accidental file loss.
Introduced a default export directory setting.
improved: Exporting to PDF and HTML is now faster and more reliable.

added: Added a missing file recovery dialog.
Introduced a local trash system for deleted notes.
improved: Closing tabs now prompts when there are unsaved changes.

added: Introduced a high-performance plain text mode for large files.
Status indicators now remain active in performance mode.
improved: Large file handling performance has been significantly improved.

added: Added spellcheck suggestions to the context menu.
Introduced custom system-level error dialogs.
improved: Caret positioning accuracy has been further refined.

added: Introduced a guided onboarding tour.
The tour can now be relaunched from settings.
improved: Tour highlights and overlays have been visually polished.

added: Added zoom controls for improved accessibility.
Tabs now remember cursor position when switching.
More Mongolian language support now available.
improved: Caret behavior on empty lines has been corrected.
fixed: Resolved multiple menu related UI glitches.

added: Added full Japanese language support across onboarding, settings, menus, and UI labels.
Added customizable background media with image/MP4 support, preview, and example media.
Introduced adaptive vibe and dominant-color accent suggestion for dynamic theming.
improved: Completed migration to Lucide icons for a more consistent icon system.
Window/header controls, tooltips, and view mode interactions were refined for better usability.
fixed: Resolved duplicate context menu behavior during spellcheck right-click.
Fixed multiple layout and visibility issues in toolbar, menubar, and view mode states.
